panels.description: Supply and return on each secondary loop, from the bench-calibrated DS18B20 pairs installed 2026-08-22. The number to read here is the supply/return spread, not the absolute temperature. Loop A is probe pair PA2 and loop B is pair PA1 — the pair number and the loop letter deliberately differ.

panels.description: Gallons used (selected range). Domestic (net) = whole-house meter total minus irrigation (sprinkler water flows through the same meter); Irrigation = integral of flow rate.
